name: A STUB OF CHALK
note: EXTRACTED from docs/118-objects-the-lines.md (THE LINES) by tools/extract-content.mjs (errata 245). Do not edit: change doc 118 and re-run. Taken from its tin in the Nugget's back room. What the turn of Pratt is written with, on Thad's own stake; kept.

LOOK_AT.say: The judges' chalk, worn to the shape of a thumb. Every lie in Consolation has been scored with it.
repeat: It writes white on anything. It has no other character, and I rather envy it.
I have stolen the one honest instrument in the Nugget. It kept the score.

LISTEN_TO.say: Nothing. Chalk at rest has nothing to add.
repeat: A dry squeak, when I try it on my thumbnail. The sound of a number about to be believed.
Nothing. It is waiting to be put to something.
